22 5931 TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANT TO SECTION 98-33(a) OF THEZONINGRESOLUTIONOF THECITYOFNEWYORK TRANSFER AND DISTRIBUTION, made as of this JY day of November, 2016, by 509-511 WEST 27 STREET LIMITED PARTNERSHIP, a New York limited partnership having an address at c/o Katsky Korins LLP, 605 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10158 ("Transferor") and PROJECT 29 WEST CHELSEA LLC,a Delaware Limited Liability WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner in fee simple of certain real property in the City of New York, designated as Block 699, Lot 26 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of (the “Granting Parcel"); and WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of the unused floor area and other development rights appurtenant to the Granting Parcel; and Lot 24, as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York and more particularly described in Exhibit II attached hereto and made a part hereof (said property being hereafter called the “Receiving Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Parcel is a “granting site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, the Receiving Parcel is a “receiving site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, certain “floor area,"as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, allowable for the development of the Granting Parcel is unused and is available for transfer pursuant toSection 98-30of theZoningResolution; and WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor has notified the City Planning Commission of New York City (hereinafter, the "CPC") of its intent to transfer two thousand four hundred and fifty (2,450) square feet of floor area (the “Development Rights") from the Granting Parcel to the Receiving Parcel; and WHEREAS,pursuant to Section 98-60 of the Zoning Resolution,an Access Easement Volume Agreement establishing a primary access easement on Block 699 was recorded in the Office of the City Register on August 4, 2014, at CRFN #2014000255149, which'Access Easement Volume Agreement satisfies the requirements of Section 98-33(d) of the Zoning Resolution as they apply to this transfer of the Development Rights; and

WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 98-33(e) of the Zoning Resolution, a Restrictive Declaration was recorded against the Granting Parcel in the Office of the City Register on March 20,2014,at CRFN #2014000102546;and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee desire to transfer the Development Rights from the Granting Parcel to the Receiving Parcel. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained,it is hereby agreed asfollows: 1. Transferor hereby grants, transfers, distributes and sets over the Development Rights from the Granting Parcel to the Receiving Parcel solely for the use and benefit in perpetuity of the Receiving Parcel (and not for the use or benefit of any other lot or parcel of land).  2. Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will receive any consideration paid for such rights as a trust fund and will apply the same first to payment of the cost of improvements before using any part of the same for any other purposes. 3. Transferee covenants that it shall not apply for nor seek or cause the issuance of a building permit by the New York City Department of Buildings (the “DOB") for any enlargement or development on theReceivingParcel thatwould involveuse of theDevelopment Rights until (i) it has provided to the New York City Department of City Planning ("DCP") a certified copy of a Notice of Zoning Lot Restrictions, in a form satisfactory to the DCP, as recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York, and (ii) notice by the DCP of its receipt of such copies hasbeengiven to theDOB. 4. This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights has been executed and delivered by Transferor without any representations, warranty or recourse of any kind. 5.7 This Transfer of Development Rights shall be recorded by Transferor against the Granting Parcel and Receiving Parcel in the Office of the Register of the City of New York, and a copy provided to the DCP in accordance with the provisions of Section 98-33(a) of the Zoning Resolution. ·６. Transferor covenants to execute and deliver from time to time,uponrequest by, and at the expense of any successor in interest, such instruments as are necessary to confirm that the property interest hereby transferred consists of the Development Rights only and does not include fee ownership of land or other ownership interests which would subject the Receiving Parcel, or any successor in interest to Transferee's interest therein, to liability for real estate taxes,water and sewer charges, or other similar governmental or public utility charges applicable to the Granting Parcel. 4814-7913-3742,v.3
